data.one_liner: Scroll indicator widget inspired by the Shopee app.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable scroll indicator widget that listens to a listview or gridview scroll controller. It allows developers to configure width, height, indicator width, and decorations for both the track and the indicator.
use_when: You want a custom Shopee-style scroll indicator for a ListView or GridView
You need a visual indicator tied to a ScrollController with custom decorations
avoid_when: You do not use a ScrollController
You require complex platform-specific scroll behaviors not covered by basic controllers
strengths: Easy to integrate with existing ScrollControllers
weaknesses: Very limited documentation and options beyond basic styling
data.minimal_example:
ScrollIndicator(
	scrollController: scrollController,
	width: 50,
	height: 5,
	indicatorWidth: 20,
	decoration: BoxDecoration(
	borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
	color: Colors.grey[300]),
	indicatorDecoration: BoxDecoration(
	color: Colors.deepOrange,
	borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
)
